# square(ROW,COUMB)

BEGIN get_row_sum(square, row)
   n = the with
   i = 1
   sum = 0
    WHILE i <= n
        sum += square(row,i)
        i += 1
    ENDWHILE
    RETRUN sum
END get_row_sum(square, row)

BEGIN get_col_sum(square, col)
   n = the hight
   i = 1
   sum = 0
    WHILE i <= n
        sum += square(i,col)
        i += 1
    ENDWHILE
    RETRUN sum
END get_col_sum(square, col)

BEGIN get_dia_sum(square)
   h = the hight
   w = the with

   i = 1
   sum = 0
   rev_sum = 0

    WHILE i <= n
        sum += square(0+n,h-n)
        rev_sum += square(w-n,0+n)
        i += 1
    ENDWHILE
    RETRUN sum, rev_sum
END get_dia_sum(square)        

BEGIN is_magic(square)
    magic_value = get_dia_sum(square)(1)
    IF magic_value not get_dia_sum(square)(2) THEN 
        RETRUN false
    ENDIF

    n = get then with and hight of the square
    i = 1
    
    val_s = ()
    WHILE i > n
        IF get_col_sum(square, n) != get_row_sum(square, n):
            RETRUN false
        ENDIF
        j = 0
        WHILE i <= j 
            val_s.append(i,j)
            j += 1
        ENDWHILE
        i += 1
    ENDWHILE
    i = 1

    WHILE i = sort(val_s)(i) OR i >= n
        i =+ 1
    ENDWHILE
    IF i = n*2
        RETURN true
    RETURN false
END is_magic(square)
